models.name: 652 E Broadway
models.roof_fit_notes: The June and July 2024 views establish the purple and yellow storefront and west approach. Rooftop equipment and the rear openings are approximate.

public_references.observation: Purple walls and a yellow west entry canopy establish the storefront.
The Broadway wall has a low centre and raised yellow ends.

models.name: 659 E Broadway
models.roof_fit_notes: The street and parking façades use 2024 finishes. The drive-through lane stays outside the ground wall. Rear cover and openings are approximate.

public_references.observation: Street-end glazing, pale awnings and standing brick pier.
Parking side confirms the elevated east entrance and glazing.
Operator confirms the address and drive-through.

models.name: 686 E Broadway
models.roof_fit_notes: The two-level glazed former brewpub uses the July 2024 Broadway reference. The lower roof, east patio cover and north entry are modeled approximations.

public_references.observation: North view shows two tall glazed bays and red upper framing.
Hilyard view shows the green canopy and lower fenced patio.

models.name: 782 E Broadway
models.roof_fit_notes: The 2024 northern frontage and hipped roof are visible. The northern entrance and vent proportions are approximate.

public_references.observation: Northern restaurant façade has cream siding, brick base and octagonal attic vent.
Oblique view shows the broad shingle roof and brick chimney.

models.name: 1432 Orchard St
models.roof_fit_notes: The 2024 photo establishes the public ground-level eastern entry, lighter upper wall and external stair. The landing and lower roof opening are approximate.

public_references.observation: Animal hospital front shows a raised upper frontage, eastern entry and external stair.

models.name: 1468–1476 Orchard Aly
models.roof_fit_notes: Three municipal points share one continuous roof. Four approximate columns support the raised parking-side volume. The modeled common side approach is approximate.

public_references.observation: Street view shows vertical upper siding over open stalls.
North oblique shows parking stall posts and access along the side.

models.name: 1505 Orchard St
models.roof_fit_notes: Four roof wings surround the planted open courtyard with a northwest gap. The interior-facing main approach and individual window positions are approximate.

public_references.observation: Orchard view shows horizontal upper wall and blue vertical skirting.
Walnut Alley elevation confirms the two levels and exposed roof overhang.

models.name: 1838 Orchard St
models.roof_fit_notes: The east side faces Orchard Street. Foliage hides some of the storefront-side roof edges and the rear service opening.

public_references.observation: Green siding, red entry and wide street-facing glazed bay distinguish the center building.

models.name: 2059 Orchard St
models.roof_fit_notes: The street entrance is reached by the modeled raised approach. The tree-obscured door position, riser height, and rear roof breaks are approximate.

public_references.observation: Street image shows the elevated entrance steps and pale siding beneath a dark roof.
